name: Boogie Cruise
detailed_description:
About This Game

Welcome aboard Boogie Cruise, a wild, action-packed indie racing game where speed meets mystery! This isn’t your ordinary racing title — it’s a pulse-pounding adventure filled with outrageous tracks, hidden secrets, and one epic dungeon waiting to test your skills.

Start your engines and blaze through a variety of high-speed, dynamic courses, each loaded with hazards, shortcuts, and surprises. From neon-lit city streets to a blistering blizzard in Level 5 — the game’s toughest challenge, every track is designed to keep your adrenaline pumping.

But Boogie Cruise has more than just racing thrills. Hidden within this vibrant world lies a legendary dungeon — a mysterious place packed with traps, puzzles, and intense action-adventure gameplay. Brave the depths as you battle enemies, uncover ancient secrets, and prepare for a showdown with a jaw-dropping, larger-than-life boss battle that will test your reflexes, strategy, and courage.

Key Features:

  •  High-speed, over-the-top racing action with varied tracks and hazards.

  •  A brutal blizzard stage (Level 5) that will push your skills to the limit.

  •  A hidden dungeon adventure filled with puzzles, enemies, and traps.

  •  An epic, cinematic boss battle that brings the story to a thrilling climax.

  •  A funky, high-energy soundtrack to keep your heart racing.

Whether you’re chasing victory on the track or fighting for your life in the dungeon, Boogie Cruise delivers a one-of-a-kind racing adventure you won’t forget.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / RTX 3070 or AMD RX 6750 XT
